captures.observation: Calls base constructor 0x1445d5880; binds this to callback 0x1445df960; invokes context helper 0x143acaa20; assigns task thread 1, callback, cancellation thread 0 and empty cancellation callback.
Passes proxy and requested mip count to constructor; allocates 0x110 bytes.

Calls 0x1445d6490; initializes task callbacks; copies render data; on missing data resets PendingFirstMip and RequestedMips to -1, cancels and sets current first LOD to -1; otherwise reads byte at render data +0x20 into current first LOD.
Copies thread-safe shared render-data pointer from component +0x5c0 and increments shared reference count.
Closure wrapper forwards captured this to 0x1445f4db0; the decompiler omits the context argument, which the callback body reads as its second argument.

If not cancelled and context proxy/render data are present, sets render data first LOD and cached resident byte, computes cumulative size delta, updates memory stat, creates a new vertex buffer, copies its retained prefix, and queues an RHI resource replacement.
Initializes old render-asset update fields, clamps requested mip count, and cancels invalid/no-change requests, consistent with 4.25 FRenderAssetUpdate constructor.

limitations: Context constructors and fields are inferred from the counterpart and need original confirmation; wrapper argument forwarding follows the callback body despite the wrapper decompiler omitting that argument.
The proxy must grant stream-out direct access to its cached resident byte (or provide unconditional equivalent access); 4.25 public cached accessors differ in editor builds.
Requires original mobile platform and render data, proxy integration, compilation and runtime validation. No native body or parity credit.
